title: Teacher Lesson Access – New active user – Existing assignment – Assigned lesson becomes visible
description: AC-01 — State Transition, Regression — Active-user recovery.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
Teacher Contact A is assigned to Lesson Alpha.
Teacher Contact A has no Salesforce User.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff creates an active Salesforce User linked to Teacher Contact A."
2. "Teacher A signs in to Back Office and opens the lesson list."
steps_result:
1. "The new user is active and linked to Teacher Contact A."
2. "The lesson list contains LT108370 Alpha."
steps_data:
1. "User status = Active; Contact = Teacher Contact A"
2. "Expected lesson = LT108370 Alpha"

title: Teacher Lesson Access – Reactivated user – Existing assignment – Assigned lesson becomes visible

preconditions:

2. "Teacher B signs in to Back Office and opens the lesson list."

2. "The lesson list contains LT108370 Bravo."
steps_data:
1. "Previous status = Inactive; New status = Active"
2. "Expected lesson = LT108370 Bravo"
